sources.name: Endless Mountains Heritage Region — 2021 North Branch Susquehanna Water Trail Guide, access table
observations: Lists Ulster Bridge Municipal Access at river mile 278.8, river right, carry-in, with 30 parking spaces nearby.
Publishes coordinate 41.849146,-76.497242 and includes Ulster Bridge to Wysox Township Park Municipal Access as an 11.3-mile favorite trip.
sources.limits: Identifies the municipal managed-access area and carry-in facility; it does not provide a surveyed water-toe coordinate.

sources.name: Pennsylvania Fish and Boat Commission — 2008 North Branch Susquehanna Section 1 map
observations: Its access table separately lists a 2008 Ulster Bridge point at 41 51 09 / -76 29 50 (41.8525,-76.497222), explicitly labeled Gravel Private.
PFBC guidance identifies nearby river hazards and launch rules; the old private coordinate is retained as superseded-history evidence only.
sources.limits: This 2008 row is not the current municipal point and should not be used as public launch access.

sources.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset Large Scale — refreshed targeted route audits
observations: At the 2021 municipal point, the matched connected Susquehanna route network is about 10 feet away; the nearest named flowline is Cash Creek.

The nearest mapped-water polygon is about 251 feet away; all three refreshed route audits have complete coverage and zero source issues. On the inventory-only Sayre-to-Towanda route, the named Susquehanna flowline is about 492 feet away and Cash Creek is about 10 feet away.
sources.limits: Hydrography confirms proximity and network connection, not the exact landing toe; the source-backed municipal site coordinate governs the access area.

decision: Use 41.849146,-76.497242 for Ulster Bridge Municipal Access. Reject the distinct 2008 private-gravel point at 41.8525,-76.497222 as a public put-in.
